facts.fact: A November 10, 2026 FTC press release reports that five states joined an FTC lawsuit alleging Hims and Hers engaged in deceptive and unlawful privacy practices.
facts.quote: Five States Join FTC Lawsuit Alleging Hims and Hers Engaged in Deceptive and Unlawful Privacy Practices

facts.fact: The FTC has scheduled a public event titled 'Understanding the Take It Down Act' for Thursday, December 10, 2026, at 1:00 PM.
facts.quote: Understanding the Take It Down Act
